scenes.title: 1 MILLION VIEWS = HOW MUCH?
scenes.say: A million views on a YouTube Short. What does it pay? Estimates say ten to seventy dollars.

scenes.title: TikTok pays past 3 gates
scenes.say: TikTok pays only past three gates: ten thousand followers, a hundred thousand views a month, and videos over one minute.

scenes.title: Same 1M views, very different pay
scenes.say: TikTok publishes no rate. Creators report fifty cents to two dollars per thousand views there. Same million: five hundred to two thousand.

scenes.title: STILL WOULD POST?
scenes.say: Most small accounts earn nothing at first. Still posting? Comment yes or no.
